contract.intent: Collect a fresh replicated real-provider baseline with separate artifact-acceptance and protocol-completion evidence.

outcomes.statement: The fresh corpus contains three independent real-provider samples per task with artifact acceptance rates.
The refreshed manifest atomically binds each observation to the corpus and its evidence files.
The fresh data reports artifact acceptance while preserving unavailable duration claims for protocol-incomplete baselines.

docs.reason: No documentation behavior is changed in this data-collection phase.

checks.command: node --check scripts/run-agentskit-os-baseline.mjs && node scripts/verify-agentskit-os-baseline.mjs --target "$AGENTSKIT_OS_ROOT" --manifest benchmarks/agentskit-os-phase-28.json --reports benchmarks/agentskit-os-phase-37-baseline --require-validation

node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('benchmarks/agentskit-os-phase-28.json')); const ok=m.observations.length===3 && m.observations.every(o=>o.durationSamplesMs?.length===3 && o.durationMs===[...o.durationSamplesMs].sort((a,b)=>a-b)[1] && o.artifactAcceptanceRate>=0 && o.artifactAcceptanceRate<=1 && o.source.startsWith('benchmarks/agentskit-os-phase-37-baseline/')); if(!ok) process.exit(1); console.log(JSON.stringify({status:'passed',criteria:['baseline-integrity'],taskCount:m.observations.length,samplesPerTask:3,artifactAcceptanceRates:m.observations.map(o=>o.artifactAcceptanceRate)}))"

pnpm --filter @agentskit/harness build && node -e "const {spawnSync}=require('child_process'); const r=spawnSync(process.execPath,['scripts/run-agentskit-os-harness-benchmark.mjs','--collect','--repeats','3','--phase-root','.codex/verification/phase-38/benchmark'],{encoding:'utf8'}); const x=JSON.parse(r.stdout.trim().split(/\r?\n/).at(-1)); const ok=x.report.qualityGate.status==='insufficient-data' && x.report.comparisons.every(c=>['baseline-incomplete','harness-not-run'].includes(c.comparability) && c.improvement.duration==='unavailable' && c.baselineArtifactAcceptanceRate!==null); if(!ok) process.exit(1); console.log(JSON.stringify({status:'passed',criteria:['comparison-integrity'],qualityGate:x.report.qualityGate.status,artifactAcceptanceRates:x.report.comparisons.map(c=>c.baselineArtifactAcceptanceRate)}))"
